checks.question: Is the terminal objective and current causal frontier explicitly known?
Does this action directly advance the frontier, falsify a blocker, or preserve required evidence/state for a selected frontier action?
Is new infrastructure strictly required because the next real mission cannot execute correctly without it?
Is this action free of repeated temporary accounts, expiring claim links, or disposable preview infrastructure on the production/promotion path?
Has this exact failure class occurred fewer than two times without a root-cause change?
Are every required post-action handle/credential/URL/lease/expiry durably stored and read back before the external mutation?
Does this verification close a currently material uncertainty rather than reproving an already sufficient property?
If an adequate route already exists, are we executing it rather than continuing research or platform search?
If user action is requested, is it a genuine external authority boundary and the smallest possible action?
